name: Lesson 6 · The tube
intro: Out of the pool and into the ocean. This reef throws a proper barrel: stall, get covered, stay balanced.

goals.hint: Press the tail (left stick down, right stick up) to slow down and let the lip throw over you
goals.hintClassic: Stall with ↓ as the lip throws over you. Tap the stick against the balance marker; hold K (B) to grab the rail

goals.hint: Crouch to fit in the barrel, correct the balance marker with small rail leans, hold K (B) for the rail grab
goals.hintClassic: Deeper is worth more. ↓ goes deeper, ↑ or Space (A) drives you out
